name: game-girl-mirror-selfie-at-home
image_purpose: Cosplay social post and character-style home portrait

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic vertical mirror selfie of an approved adult in an action-video-game-inspired cosplay, preserving the light-brown hair, gloves, black skirt, white top, phone case, and bedroom props.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long straight light-brown hair and face-framing bangs, thoughtful slightly pouting expression and one index finger near the lip. Wear a white sleeveless crop top with secure coverage, black pleated skirt with supplied waistband marking, black opaque tights, fingerless gauntlet gloves with silver and red accents, shoulder straps, and black upper-arm band.
prompt.composition_elements: Kneeling or sitting on a beige carpet while taking a high-angle mirror selfie with a white smartphone and white pop-it textured case. Include paneled door, photo collage, white angel wings decoration, shelving with plushies, sofa or futon, blue-white plush cushion, and pink tumbler. Vertical 9:16.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft indoor room lighting, realistic fabric and prop texture, candid action-cosplay atmosphere, accurate mirror reflection.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone mirror selfie, vertical 9:16, high-angle perspective, natural proportions, crisp outfit and prop details.
